#load annotation

```{r}
annotation_edp <- fread("ref/EDPnew_20240409.bed") %>%
  mutate(chromStart = chromStart -500, chromEnd = chromEnd +500) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom = `#chrom`, chromStart, chromEnd, name)

annotation_genehancer <- fread("ref/genehancer/genehancer_hg38.tsv", select = c(1,2,3,4,10,11),
                    col.names = c("chrom", "chromStart", "chromEnd", "name", "evidence", "type" ))%>%
  mutate(chromStart = chromStart -500, chromEnd = chromEnd +500) 


transcript_annot <- fread("ref/MANE.GRCh38.v1.3.ensembl_genomic.gff.gz",skip ="chr1", fill = T) %>%
  filter(str_detect(V9, "MANE_Select"), V3 == "exon")%>%
 mutate(gene_name=  str_extract(V9, "(?<=gene_name=)[^;]+"),
         transcript_id= str_extract(V9, "(?<=transcript_id=)[^;]+")) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames = V1, start = V4, end = V5, strand = V7, type = V3, gene_name, transcript_id)

BRCA1_annotation <- fread("/reference/gene_models/GRCh38_gencode_v41/primary_files/gencode.v41.annotation_comprehensive.gtf") %>%
  filter(str_detect(V9, "BRCA1|NBR2"), V3 == "exon")%>%
  mutate(gene_name= sub('.*gene_name \"([^;]*)\".*',"\\1", V9),
         transcript_id= sub('.*transcript_id \"([^;]*)\".*',"\\1", V9),) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames = V1, start = V4, end = V5, strand = V7, type = V3, gene_name, transcript_id) %>%
  filter(transcript_id %in% c("ENST00000357654.9", "ENST00000657841.1"))


isl_annot <- fread("ref/cpg_islands_ucsc.bed") %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd) 

isl_complete <- isl_annot %>%
  mutate(type = "Island")  %>%
  rbind(., isl_annot %>%mutate(chromEnd = chromStart, chromStart = chromStart - 2000,, type = "Shore")) %>%
  rbind(., isl_annot %>%mutate(chromStart = chromEnd, chromEnd = chromEnd + 2000,, type = "Shore")) %>%
  rbind(., isl_annot %>%mutate(chromEnd = chromStart- 2000, chromStart = chromStart - 4000,, type = "Shelf")) %>%
  rbind(., isl_annot %>%mutate(chromStart = chromEnd+2000, chromEnd = chromEnd + 4000,, type = "Shelf"))
```

### PDX mRNA

```{r}
library(edgeR)
mrna_hom_me_list <- list("134011", "134062", "SFRC01585", "SFRC01334S1","WEHI_CS62", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30")

mRNA_batch1 <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2025.genes.ExpectedCounts.csv") 


mRNA_batch2 <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2026.genes.ExpectedCounts.csv") 

gene_list <- mRNA_batch1 %>%
  dplyr::select( -starts_with("134"), -starts_with("S"), -starts_with("O")) %>%
  mutate(Length = `Gene End (bp)` - `Gene Start (bp)`) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Ensembl Gene ID")
mRNA_cnts <- mRNA_batch1 %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("134")|starts_with("SF")|starts_with("O")|starts_with("SO")) %>%
  left_join(mRNA_batch2 %>%
              dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("SF") ), by = "gene_ID")


mRNA_cnts <- mRNA_cnts %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "gene_ID")

sample_list <- data.frame(sample = colnames(mRNA_cnts) ) %>%
    mutate(batch = if_else(sample %in% colnames(mRNA_batch1), "batch1", "batch2")) %>%
  separate(sample, into = c("sample", "drop"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  dplyr::select(-drop) %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("S1|S2", "",sample), 
         BRCA1 = if_else(sample %in% mrna_hom_me_list, "Hom", "Het"))
  

star_matrix <- DGEList(counts = mRNA_cnts, group = factor(sample_list$BRCA1),batch = factor(sample_list$batch), samples = sample_list, genes = gene_list)

boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)     

keep <- filterByExpr(star_matrix)
design.mat <- model.matrix(~star_matrix$samples$group+star_matrix$samples$batch)
star_matrix <- star_matrix[keep,, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
star_matrix <- calcNormFactors(star_matrix)
boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)    

prior_count <- 2
lib_size <- star_matrix$samples$lib.size * star_matrix$samples$norm.factors
scaled_prior_count <- prior_count * lib_size / mean(lib_size)
adj_lib_size <- lib_size + 2 * scaled_prior_count

fpkm <- t((t(star_matrix$counts) + scaled_prior_count) / adj_lib_size) * 1e6 / star_matrix$genes$Length * 1e3
tpm <- t(t(fpkm) / colSums(fpkm)) * 1e6
log_tpm <- log2(tpm)

lib_size <- colSums(star_matrix$counts)

# pdx_cpm <- data.frame(log2(t( t(star_matrix$counts) / lib_size * 1e6 )), check.names = F) %>%
#   rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID") %>%
#   left_join(gene_list %>%
#               dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`) %>%
#               rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID")) %>%
#   pivot_longer(-c("ENSG_ID", "Associated Gene Name"), names_to = "sample", values_to = "log_tpm")%>%
#   left_join(mRNA_mapping)
mRNA_mapping<- data.frame(sample = c( "134011_2058_T3","134048_7496_T2","134062_2233_T3" ,"134169_6606_T2", "SFRC01428S1_22235_T2", "SFRC01495S2_1537_T1.x","SFRC01495S2_1537_T1.y", "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3.x" , "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3.y" , "SFRC01334S1_107_T5", "SOLACE20126S1_25285_T2" ), alt_name = c("#11", "#48","#62" ,"#169", "#428", "#495_1","#495_2", "#585_1" ,"#585_2" , "#334",  "#951"),
                          meBRCA1 = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1",   "Het meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1","Het meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1",  "Het meBRCA1"))


pdx_tpm <- data.frame(log_tpm, check.names = F) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID") %>%
  left_join(gene_list %>%
              dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`) %>%
              rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c("ENSG_ID", "Associated Gene Name"), names_to = "sample", values_to = "log_tpm")%>%
  left_join(mRNA_mapping)



pdx_sample_selection <- fread("mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2025_RNASeQC_metrics.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.Label, `Expression Profiling Efficiency`, `Total Purity Filtered Reads Sequenced`) %>%
  mutate(batch = "batch1") %>%
  rbind(fread("mRNA/Kondrashova_-_HRD_-_RNAseq_Feb_2026_RNASeQCv1_metrics.tsv")%>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.Label = `Sample Label`, `Expression Profiling Efficiency`, `Total Purity Filtered Reads Sequenced`)%>% mutate(batch = "batch2") ) %>%
  group_by(Sample.Label) %>%
  filter(n()>1,`Total Purity Filtered Reads Sequenced` == max(`Total Purity Filtered Reads Sequenced`) ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(Sample.Label = if_else(batch =="batch1", paste(Sample.Label, "x", sep = "."), paste(Sample.Label, "y", sep = ".")))

pdx_mrna <- pdx_tpm%>%
  filter( !str_detect(sample, "x|y") |sample %in%pdx_sample_selection$Sample.Label) %>%
  mutate(alt_name = gsub("_1|_2", "", alt_name),
    meBRCA1 = factor(meBRCA1, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1", "Mut BRCA1", "Restored BRCA1")),
         type = "PDX")
```

### ICGC mRNA & methylation

```{r}
library(edgeR)
mRNA <- Sys.glob(paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/raw/20220505_ICGC_OV_meth/mRNA/*gene*ounts*"))%>%
    map_dfr(~ as.data.frame(fread(.x)))


icgc_dna_sample <- fread("/mnt/lustre/working/genomeinfo/share/analysis/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project.StudyPairedAnalysis_20220407.tsv") %>%
  dplyr::select(dnaSampleLabel = testSampleLabel, SampleType = testSampleType, testQpureCellularity, donorLabel = testDonorLabel, dnaSampleSubmittedWithID = testSampleSubmittedWithID, dnaSampleDescription = testSampleDescription)

icgc_mRNA_sample <- fread("/mnt/lustre/working/genomeinfo/share/analysis/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project/RNASeq_July2019Run_ross/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project_2019.StudyRnaSeqReport.csv") %>%
   dplyr::select(sampleLabel, SampleType, donorLabel, sampleSubmittedWithID, sampleDescription) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(dnaSampleSubmittedWithID = gsub("DNA biospcimen id ", "", str_extract(sampleDescription, "(?i)DNA biospcimen id[: ]+.*"))) %>%
  left_join(icgc_dna_sample)
  

gene_list <- mRNA %>%
  dplyr::select( -starts_with("ICGC"), -starts_with("EXTERN")) %>%
  mutate(Length = `Gene End (bp)` - `Gene Start (bp)`) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Ensembl Gene ID")

mRNA_cnts <- mRNA%>%
  dplyr::select(gene_ID = `Ensembl Gene ID`, starts_with("ICGC")|starts_with("EXTERN"), -Strand) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "gene_ID")

sample_list <- data.frame(sample = colnames(mRNA_cnts) ) %>%
  left_join(icgc_mRNA_sample %>%
              mutate(sample = paste(sampleLabel, sampleSubmittedWithID, sep = "_"))) %>%
  mutate(type = if_else(SampleType == "Normal control (other site)", "N", "T"))
  
sample_list$total_counts <- colSums(mRNA[,9:142])
star_matrix <- DGEList(counts = mRNA_cnts, group = factor(sample_list$type), samples = sample_list, genes = gene_list)

boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)     

keep <- filterByExpr(star_matrix)
design.mat <- model.matrix(~star_matrix$samples$group)
star_matrix <- star_matrix[keep,, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
star_matrix <- calcNormFactors(star_matrix)
boxplot(cpm(star_matrix, log =T), use.cols = T)    

prior_count <- 2
lib_size <- star_matrix$samples$lib.size * star_matrix$samples$norm.factors
scaled_prior_count <- prior_count * lib_size / mean(lib_size)
adj_lib_size <- lib_size + 2 * scaled_prior_count

fpkm <- t((t(star_matrix$counts) + scaled_prior_count) / adj_lib_size) * 1e6 / star_matrix$genes$Length * 1e3
tpm <- t(t(fpkm) / colSums(fpkm)) * 1e6
log_tpm <- log2(tpm)


ICGC_tpm <- data.frame(log_tpm, check.names = F) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID") %>%
  left_join(gene_list %>%
              dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`) %>%
              rownames_to_column("ENSG_ID")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c("ENSG_ID", "Associated Gene Name"), names_to = "sample", values_to = "log_tpm")%>%
```

# QC plot

##pca

```{r}
meth_mat <- cell_line_5mc %>%
  mutate(pos = paste(chrom, start, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(pos, fraction_mod, Sample) %>%
  rbind(pdx_5mc %>%
  mutate(pos = paste(chrom, start, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(pos, fraction_mod, Sample) ) %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = fraction_mod) %>%
  drop_na()

meth_mat <-meth_mat %>%
  column_to_rownames("pos")

cpg_var <- apply(meth_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)

cutoff <- quantile(cpg_var, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)
top10_cpgs <- names(cpg_var)[cpg_var >= cutoff]

meth_top10 <- meth_mat[top10_cpgs, ]
saveRDS(meth_top10, "intermediate/top10percent_cpg.RDS")

meth_top10 <- readRDS("intermediate/top10percent_cpg.RDS")
pca <- prcomp(t(meth_top10), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)


pheno = data.frame(sample = colnames(meth_top10)) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "PDX"),
         meBRCA1= case_when(sample %in% het_me_list ~ "Het meBRCA1",
                            sample %in% hom_me_list ~ "Hom meBRCA1",
                            sample %in% c("UWB1", "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53") ~ "Mut BRCA1",
                            sample %in% c("UWB1_BRCA1") ~ "Func BRCA1",))


pca_df <- data.frame(

  PC1 = pca$x[,1],
  PC2 = pca$x[,2],
  group = pheno$meBRCA1,
  type = pheno$sample_type,
  sample = pheno$sample
)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, aes(shape = type)) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2,1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2,2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label= sample))+
  theme_classic()




```

## sequencing quality

```{r}
library(ggridges)

qscore <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = c("mean_qscore_template", "alignment_genome")) %>%
            filter(alignment_genome %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))%>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) 

coverage <- Sys.glob("output/*/coverage/*mosdepth.summary.txt")%>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x)%>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_unphased.mosdepth.summary.txt", "", basename(.x)),
                   sample = gsub("\\.mosdepth.summary.txt", "", sample))) %>%
  mutate(chrom = factor(chrom, level = paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom))

nanopore_len <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/QC/*_summary.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, select = c("sequence_length_template", "alignment_genome")) %>%
            filter(alignment_genome %in% paste0("chr", seq(1,22)))%>%
            mutate(sample = gsub("_summary.tsv", "", basename(.x)))) 


nanopore_len  %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(med = median(sequence_length_template))

coverage%>%
  group_by(sample, chrom) %>%
  summarise(coverage = round(sum(mean *bases / sum(bases)), 0)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(med = median(coverage))

qscore  %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(med = median(mean_qscore_template))

len_plot <- nanopore_len %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  sample_n(n()/100) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "PDX")) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping) %>%
  mutate(alt_name = factor(alt_name,
  levels =c ("WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth", "OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1", "PDX #11",  "PDX #62","PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #169","PDX #48", "PDX #428", "PDX #495",  "PDX #865", "PDX #951"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sequence_length_template , y= alt_name, fill = sample_type))+
  stat_density_ridges(quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text = element_blank())+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_y", strip.position = "right", nrow = 2)+
  scale_x_continuous(transform = "log10", name = "Read Length (bp)")+
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette, "Model type")

qscore_plot <- qscore %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  sample_n(n()/100) %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "PDX")) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping) %>%
  mutate(alt_name = factor(alt_name,
  levels =c ("WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth", "OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1", "PDX #11",  "PDX #62", "PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #169","PDX #48", "PDX #428", "PDX #495",  "PDX #865", "PDX #951"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = mean_qscore_template, x= alt_name, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none")+
  ylab("Mean Base Quality Score")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette)


coverage_plot <-coverage %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(coverage = round(sum(mean *bases / sum(bases)), 0)) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  mutate(sample_type = if_else( sample %in% cell_line, "Cell-line", "PDX")) %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping) %>%
   mutate(alt_name = factor(alt_name,
  levels =c ("WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth", "OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1", "PDX #11",  "PDX #62","PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #169","PDX #48", "PDX #428", "PDX #495",  "PDX #865", "PDX #951"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = alt_name, y = coverage, fill = sample_type))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~sample_type, scale = "free_x", strip.position = "top")+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_text(aes(label=paste0(coverage, "x")), vjust=0)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
       axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
       legend.position = "none",
       axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  ylab("Averaged Depth")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_type_palette, "Sample")


merged_plot <- ggarrange(len_plot,ggarrange(coverage_plot, qscore_plot, ncol = 2, align= "v", labels = c("B)", "C)")),  nrow =2 , common.legend = T, legend = "bottom", labels = c("A)", ""))
ggsave(plot = merged_plot, filename = "plots/nanopore_cell_line_qc.pdf",  width = 260, height = 297, units = "mm")
```

```{r}
  rowwise() %>%

  arrange(donorLabel)

         str_detect(V9, "MANE")) %>%
  mutate(width = abs(V5-V4+1),
         feature = str_match(V9, 'gene_type "([^"]+)";')[,2],

         symbol =  str_match(V9, 'gene_name "([^"]+)";')[,2],
         chromosome = gsub("chr", "", V1),
         symbol2 = paste(symbol, transcript, sep = ";")) %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosome, start = V4, end = V5, width,  strand = V7, feature, gene, exon, exon_num, transcript, symbol, symbol2)
```

```{r}
c(Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/LUNG_bam/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"),
         Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"))%>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%
            dplyr::select(Chromosome = chromosome, Start_position = start, End_position =end, total_cn = copyNumber, B_cn = minorAlleleCopyNumber) %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=/output/)[^/]+")))%>%
  mutate(total_cn = round(total_cn)) %>%
  group_by(SampleID, Chromosome, grp = cumsum( lag(total_cn, default = first(total_cn)) != total_cn)) %>%
  summarise(
    Start_position = first(Start_position),
    End_position = last(End_position),
    total_cn = first(total_cn),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-grp)%>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Chromosome = gsub("chr", "hs", Chromosome) )%>%
  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_walk(~fwrite(.x,file = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/", "output/circos/" , unique(.y$SampleID), "_savana_copynumber.tsv"),sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F))



c(Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/LUNG_bam/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"),

  map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%

  mutate( B_cn = if_else(is.na(B_cn), 0, round(B_cn, 4))) %>%

  ) %>%

  group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_walk(~fwrite(.x,file = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/", "output/circos/" , unique(.y$SampleID), "_savana_BAF.tsv"),sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F))


 
  SV <- c(Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/SV/*.nanomonsv.result.vcf"),
          Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/LUNG_bam/output/*/SV/*.nanomonsv.result.vcf"))%>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, skip = "#CHROM") %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=/output/)[^/]+")))%>%
  filter(`#CHROM` %in% c(paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X", "Y"))),
         !str_detect(ALT, "_mus_GRCm39"),
         FILTER == "PASS") %>%
  mutate(SV_type = str_extract(INFO, "(?<=SVTYPE=)[^;]+"),
         CHR_end = if_else(SV_type == "BND",
                           str_extract(ALT, "chr[0-9XY]+(_mus_GRCm39)?"),
                           `#CHROM`),
         POS_end = if_else(SV_type == "BND", 
                           as.numeric(str_extract_all(ALT, "(?<=:)[0-9]+")),
                           as.numeric(str_extract(INFO, "(?<=END=)[^;]+"))))  %>%
    filter(CHR_end %in% c(paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X", "Y"))))%>%
    mutate(`#CHROM`  = gsub("chr", "hs", `#CHROM`),
            CHR_end = gsub("chr", "hs", CHR_end),) 
  
  
  #interchromosomal
  SV %>%
    filter(SV_type == "BND", `#CHROM` != CHR_end) %>%
    separate(ID, into = c("ID_1", "ID_2", "ID_3")) %>%
    group_by(SampleID, ID_1, ID_2)%>%
    filter(n()>1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(ID = paste(ID_1, ID_2, sep = "_"),
           POS_2 = POS+1) %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, `#CHROM` , POS,POS_2, SampleID ) %>%
    group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_walk(~fwrite(.x,file = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/", "output/circos/" , unique(.y$SampleID), "_nanomonSV_translocation.tsv"),sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F))
  
   #deletion
   SV %>%
    filter(SV_type == "DEL") %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, `#CHROM` , POS,POS_end, SampleID ) %>%
    dt_pivot_longer(cols = c(POS, POS_end), values_to = "POS", names_to = "Name") %>%
     dplyr::select(-Name) %>%
     mutate(POS_2 = POS+1)%>%
     arrange(SampleID, ID) %>%
    group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_walk(~fwrite(.x,file = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/", "output/circos/" , unique(.y$SampleID), "_nanomonSV_deletion.tsv"),sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F))
   
    #duplication
   SV %>%
    filter(SV_type == "DUP")  %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, `#CHROM` , POS,POS_end, SampleID ) %>%
    dt_pivot_longer(cols = c(POS, POS_end), values_to = "POS", names_to = "Name") %>%
     dplyr::select(-Name) %>%
     mutate(POS_2 = POS+1)%>%
     arrange(SampleID, ID) %>%
    group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_walk(~fwrite(.x,file = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/", "output/circos/" , unique(.y$SampleID), "_nanomonSV_duplication.tsv"),sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F))
   
  #intrachromosomal
    SV %>%
    filter(SV_type == "BND", `#CHROM` == CHR_end) %>%
    separate(ID, into = c("ID_1", "ID_2", "ID_3")) %>%
    group_by(SampleID, ID_1, ID_2)%>%
    filter(n()>1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(ID = paste(ID_1, ID_2, sep = "_"),
           POS_2 = POS+1) %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, `#CHROM` , POS,POS_2, SampleID ) %>%
    group_by(SampleID) %>%
  group_walk(~fwrite(.x,file = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/", "output/circos/" , unique(.y$SampleID), "_nanomonSV_intrachromosomal.tsv"),sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F, col.names = F))
```

```{r}
reload <- methRead(list("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/OVCAR8amp_style.txt",
                        "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/OVCAR8_LP_H4_53amp_style.txt"),
                   sample.id = list("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_H4_53"),

meth = methylKit::unite(filtered_reload,destrand = F)
dmp_cell_line <- calculateDiffMeth(meth, mc.cores = 12)
saveRDS(dmp_cell_line, file = "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/cell_line_OVCAR8_H453.RDS")


reload <- methRead(list("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/UWB1amp_style.txt" ,
                        "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/UWB1_BRCA1amp_style.txt"),
                   sample.id = list("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1"),
                   assembly = "hg38",
                   treatment = c(1, 0),
                   context="CpG")
filtered_reload <- filterByCoverage(reload, lo.count =5, hi.count = 100)
meth = methylKit::unite(filtered_reload,destrand = F)
dmp_cell_line <- calculateDiffMeth(meth, mc.cores = 12)
saveRDS(dmp_cell_line, file = "/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/cell_line_UWB1.RDS")


OVCAR8_A630_dmp <- readRDS("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/cell_line_OVCAR8_A630.RDS")


OVCAR8_H453_dmp <- readRDS("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/cell_line_OVCAR8_H453.RDS")
UWB1_dmp <- readRDS("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/methylkit_loading/cell_line_UWB1.RDS")

hrd_dmp_OVCAR8_A630 <- data.frame(getMethylDiff(OVCAR8_A630_dmp, qvalue = 0.05, diff = 0.1)) 
hrd_dmp_OVCAR8_H453 <- data.frame(getMethylDiff(OVCAR8_H453_dmp, qvalue = 0.05, diff = 0.1)) 
hrd_dmp_UWB1<- data.frame(getMethylDiff(UWB1_dmp, qvalue = 0.05, diff = 0.1))

joined_dmp <- hrd_dmp_OVCAR8_A630%>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, end, qvalue_A630 = qvalue, meth.diff_A630= meth.diff) %>%
  mutate(change = meth.diff_A630>0) %>%
  full_join(hrd_dmp_OVCAR8_H453%>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, end, qvalue_H453 = qvalue, meth.diff_H453= meth.diff) %>%
    mutate(change = meth.diff_H453>0) ) %>%
  full_join(hrd_dmp_UWB1 %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start, end, qvalue_u = qvalue, meth.diff_u= meth.diff) %>%
    mutate(change = meth.diff_u>0) ) %>%
  mutate(position = paste(chr, start, change,sep = "_"))


library(eulerr)
fit <- euler(list(`OVCAR8 LP A6-30 `= joined_dmp %>% filter(!is.na(qvalue_A630))%>%pull(position),
                  `OVCAR8 LP H4-53` = joined_dmp %>% filter(!is.na(qvalue_H453))%>%pull(position),
                  `UWB1` = joined_dmp %>% filter(!is.na(qvalue_u))%>%pull(position)))

pdf("plots/VENN_DIAGRAM_DMP.pdf")
plot(fit,fill =c("#ffa62b","#16697a", "#82c0cc"), quantities = T )
dev.off()


joined_dmp %>%
  group_by(change) %>%
  summarise(`OVCAR8 LP A6-30`= sum(!is.na(meth.diff_A630)),
            `OVCAR8 LP H4-53` = sum(!is.na(meth.diff_H453)),
            UWB1 = sum(!is.na(meth.diff_u))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("OVCAR8 LP A6-30", "OVCAR8 LP H4-53", "UWB1"), names_to = "HRD", values_to = "#DMP") %>%
  mutate(change = if_else(change, "higher in HRD", "lower in HRD")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = HRD, y = `#DMP`, fill = change))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("higher in HRD" = "#ed6a5a", "lower in HRD" = "#5ca4a9"))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("plots/DMP_counts_isogenic.pdf", height = 4, width = 5.5)
```

```{r}
  filter(!Sample== "WEHI_CS62") %>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = fraction_mod) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(A6_30 = OVCAR8_LP_A6_30-OVCAR8,
         H4_53 = OVCAR8_LP_H4_53 - OVCAR8,
         U = UWB1 - UWB1_BRCA1) 

global_diff_iso %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = U, y =H4_53))+
  geom_bin2d()+
  scale_fill_viridis_c( trans = "log2", name = "density")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5))

  left_join(cell_line_5mc %>%
```

```{r}
library(ggfortify)
library(fastcluster)

row_vars <- apply(hm, 1, var)
top_rows <- order(row_vars, decreasing = TRUE)[1:5000]

hc <- fastcluster::hclust(dist(mat_subset))
hc_col <- fastcluster::hclust(dist(t(mat_subset)))

hr_annot <- c("het meBRCA1", "hom meBRCA1", "hom meBRCA1", "het meBRCA1", "het meBRCA1", "het meBRCA1", "het meBRCA1", "hom meBRCA1", "het meBRCA1","het meBRCA1")
names(hr_annot) <- colnames(hm)

pdf("plots/top_5000_var_islpro_dmp.pdf", height = 6, width = 8)
Heatmap(mat_subset, name = "Methylation", cluster_rows = as.dendrogram(hc), show_row_names = F, show_column_names = T, cluster_columns = as.dendrogram(hc_col), 
        top_annotation = columnAnnotation(meBRCA1 = hr_annot, col = list(meBRCA1 = c("hom meBRCA1" = "#f2c14e", "het meBRCA1" ="#f78154"))))
dev.off()

pca_res <- prcomp(t(hm), scale. = F)
autoplot(pca_res, label = T, label.repel = T, label.size = 2, x = 1, y = 2, color = c("#f78154","#f2c14e", "#f2c14e", "#f78154","#f78154","#f78154","#f78154","#f2c14e", "#f78154","#f78154"))+
  theme_bw()
ggsave("plots/isl_pro_dmp_pca.pdf", height = 3.5, width = 3.5)
```

#DMP non fisher

```{r}
islpro <- readRDS("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/islpro.rds") %>%
  filter(! str_detect(SampleID, "OVCAR8") , ! str_detect(SampleID, "UWB1") )


CNV <- c(Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/LUNG_bam/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"),
         Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/*/savana/*_segmented_absolute_copy_number.tsv"))%>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%
            dplyr::select(Chromosome = chromosome, Start_position = start, End_position =end, total_cn = copyNumber, B_cn = minorAlleleCopyNumber) %>%
            mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=/output/)[^/]+")))%>%
  mutate(total_cn = round(total_cn), B_cn = if_else(is.na(B_cn), 0, round(B_cn)),
    A_cn = total_cn - B_cn) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr =Chromosome, cn_start = Start_position , cn_end = End_position, cn =total_cn, SampleID)

meth_cn <- islpro %>%
  left_join(CNV, by = join_by("SampleID"=="SampleID", "chr" == "chr", "start" >= "cn_start", "start" <= "cn_end"))%>%
  mutate(adjme = round(me_percent *cn /100),
         fullme = adjme==cn,
         fullunme = adjme ==0) %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(SampleID %in% c(hom_me_list, "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53", "UWB1"), "hom", "het"))

meth_cn %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, group) %>%
  distinct()

meth_cn = data.table(meth_cn)

summary_data <- meth_cn[, .(
  FullyMethylated_Group1 = sum(fullme[group == "hom"], na.rm = TRUE),
  FullyUnmethylated_Group1 = sum(fullunme[group == "hom"], na.rm = TRUE),
  FullyMethylated_Group2 = sum(fullme[group == "het"], na.rm = TRUE),
  FullyUnmethylated_Group2 = sum(fullunme[group == "het"], na.rm = TRUE),
  Total_Group1 = sum(group == "hom"),
  Total_Group2 = sum(group == "het")),
by = pos]


summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(sig = (FullyMethylated_Group1 == 2)&(FullyMethylated_Group2 == 0)) 

rle_result <- rle(summary_data$sig)

valid_indices <- rep(rle_result$lengths > 3& rle_result$values, rle_result$lengths)

summary_data_fully_methylated <- summary_data[valid_indices, ] %>% 
  separate(pos, into =c ("chrom", "pos")) %>%
  mutate(pos = as.numeric(pos)) %>%
  left_join(annotation_edp, by = join_by(chrom == chrom, pos >= chromStart, pos <= chromEnd)) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("name", "drop")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-"drop")

fully_methylated_changes <- rbind(summary_data_fully_methylated  %>%
  filter(!is.na(name)),
  summary_data_fully_methylated  %>%
  filter(is.na(name))%>%
    dplyr::select(-c(chromStart, chromEnd, name)) %>%
    left_join(annotation_genehancer %>%
                dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, pos >= chromStart, pos <= chromEnd)))
    


changed_cpg <- fully_methylated_changes %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name, pos) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  inner_join(pdx_5mc %>%
              filter(Sample != "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3"), by = join_by(chrom == chrom, chromStart <= start, chromEnd >= end)) %>%
  inner_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::rename(Sample= sample)) %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(Sample %in% c(het_me_list, "UWB1_BRCA1"), "HRP", "HRD")) 

saveRDS(changed_cpg, "intermediate/non_fisher_changed_cpg.RDS")

changed_cpg <- readRDS("intermediate/non_fisher_changed_cpg.RDS")

changed_cpg_clean <- changed_cpg %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, chromStart, chromEnd, name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(transcript_annot, by = join_by(chrom ==seqnames, chromEnd >= start, chromStart<=end)) %>%
  mutate(name = if_else(nchar(name) ==11, gene_name, name)) %>%
  filter(name == gene_name) %>%
  group_by(chrom, name) %>%
  mutate(new_chromStart = min(chromStart), new_chromEnd = chromEnd) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom,chromStart, chromEnd, name, new_chromStart, new_chromEnd) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(changed_cpg) %>%
  dplyr::select(-chromStart, -chromEnd) %>%
  dplyr::rename(chromStart=new_chromStart, chromEnd = new_chromEnd)%>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(alt_name)>5) %>%
  mutate(HR = if_else(HR == "HRP", "Het meBRCA1", "Hom meBRCA1"),
         HR =  factor(HR, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1", "Het meBRCA1")))

mRNA_pdx_plot <- annotation_edp %>%
  separate(name, into = c("name", "drop") ) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, edp_start = chromStart, edp_end = chromEnd, gene_name = name) %>%
 inner_join(changed_cpg_clean %>%
              mutate(alt_name =gsub("PDX ", "",alt_name)), by = join_by(chrom== chrom,gene_name == name)) %>%
  left_join(rbind(pdx_tpm %>%
              filter(alt_name != "#585") %>%
              dplyr::select(alt_name, log_tpm, gene_name = `Associated Gene Name`)
            #   ,
            # ovcar8_tpm %>%
            #   dplyr::select(alt_name, log_tpm, gene_name = `Associated Gene Name`)) %>%
            #   rbind(., uwb1_tpm%>%
            #   dplyr::select(alt_name, log_tpm, gene_name = `Associated Gene Name`)
            ))%>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::select( log_tpm, HR, alt_name, gene_name) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
         name = factor(name, levels = c( "BNC1", "BRCA1",  "CCDC180", "HS3ST2","KATNAL2","MROH6", "PTGER4","SYCP2","TP53TG3D",  "ZIC1", "FOXF1", "GLIPR1L1", "HOXC11", "HOXC12", "HOXD10", "IGSF21",  "KCNA7","PAX3","SPATA32", "TMEM132D"))) %>%
  filter(name == "BNC1") %>%
  left_join(icgc_dna_sample %>%
```

```{r}
mean_norm_meth <- icgc_meth_plot %>%
  filter(Sample_Group =="Solid Tissue Normal") %>%
  group_by(start) %>%
  summarise(mean_non_meth_beta = mean(beta))

normal_bnc1 <- icgc_meth_plot %>%
  filter(Sample_Group =="Solid Tissue Normal")%>%
    ggplot( aes(x = start, y= beta, group = Sample.ID))+
    geom_point()+
    geom_line()+
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), name = "Methylation (beta)")+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title.x = element_blank(),legend.box="vertical", legend.margin = margin(), legend.spacing.x = unit(0, "mm"),  legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "mm"))+
  facet_wrap(~Sample_Group )


ICGC_cn <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/HRDmethyl_public/data/raw/20220505_ICGC_OV_meth/copynumber/*") %>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%
            filter(chromosome == 15, start <=83284315 , end >=83285176) %>%
            mutate(V1 = basename(.x)) )%>%
  separate(V1, into = c("CaseID", "Sample_Name"), sep = "_", extra = "drop") %>%
  separate(Sample_Name, into = c("Sample_Name"), sep = "\\.", extra = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Sample.ID  = paste(gsub("-", "_", CaseID),gsub("-", "_", Sample_Name),sep = "_")) 

ov_purity <- Sys.glob("/working/genomeinfo/share/analysis/AOCS_-_ICGC_ovarian_cancer_project/ascat/summary_stats/*") %>%
   map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%
             mutate(V1 = basename(.x)))%>%
  separate(V1, into = c("CaseID", "Sample_Name"), sep = "_", extra = "drop") %>%
  separate(Sample_Name, into = c("Sample_Name"), sep = "\\.", extra = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Sample.ID  = paste(gsub("-", "_", CaseID),gsub("-", "_", Sample_Name),sep = "_")) 

tumor_bnc1 <- icgc_meth_plot %>%
  filter(Sample_Group == "Primary Tumour") %>%
  group_by(Donor) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Tissue_type) >1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(mean_norm_meth) %>%
  left_join(ICGC_cn %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample.ID,CN = tumour.total.cn )) %>%
  left_join(ov_purity%>%
              dplyr::select(purity,Sample.ID ))%>%
   mutate(mt = ((beta * (purity * CN + 2 * (1 - purity)) - 2 * mean_non_meth_beta * (1- purity)))/ (purity * CN),
          mt = if_else(mt >1, 1, mt),
          Tissue_type  =gsub("12|7", "", Tissue_type)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =c(beta, mt), names_to = "beta_type", values_to = "beta") %>%
  mutate(beta_type = if_else(beta_type == "mt", "cn & purity corrected", "raw beta"),
         beta_type= factor(beta_type , levels = c("raw beta", "cn & purity corrected"))) %>%
    ggplot( aes(x = start, y= beta, group = Sample.ID, color = Donor ))+
    geom_point()+
    geom_line(aes(linetype = Tissue_type))+
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), name = "Methylation (beta)")+
    theme_bw()+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title.x = element_blank(),legend.box="vertical", legend.margin = margin(), legend.spacing.x = unit(0, "mm"),  legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "mm"))+
  facet_wrap(~beta_type, nrow = 2)



ggarrange(normal_bnc1 ,tumor_bnc1, nrow = 2, labels = c("A)", "B)"), heights = c(0.3, 0.6))


ggsave("plots/supplementary_icgc_bnc1_sample_type.pdf", height = 10, width = 7)
```

```{r}

pmd_files <- list.files("output/MMSeekR", pattern="*_MMSeekR_models.multiModel.PMDs.bed", full.names=TRUE)

pmd_common <- fread("output/MMSeekR/common_pmd_g0.7.bed") 
pmd_common_gr <-  GRanges(seqnames = pmd_common$V1, ranges = IRanges(pmd_common$V2, pmd_common$V3))

# Optional: name each element by sample name
sample_names <- gsub("_MMSeekR_models.multiModel.PMDs.bed", "", basename(pmd_files))

# Import as GRanges
pmd_list <- lapply(pmd_files, function(f) {
  df <- fread(f, header=FALSE)
  GRanges(seqnames = df$V1, ranges = IRanges(df$V2, df$V3))
})
names(pmd_list) <- sample_names


seqlengths <- c(
  chr1=248956422, chr2=242193529, chr3=198295559,
  chr4=190214555, chr5=181538259, chr6=170805979,
  chr7=159345973, chr8=145138636, chr9=138394717,
  chr10=133797422, chr11=135086622, chr12=133275309,
  chr13=114364328, chr14=107043718, chr15=101991189,
  chr16=90338345, chr17=83257441, chr18=80373285,
  chr19=58617616, chr20=64444167, chr21=46709983,
  chr22=50818468, chrX=156040895
)

bins <- tileGenome(
  seqlengths = seqlengths,
  tilewidth = 50000,
  cut.last.tile.in.chrom = TRUE
)
mcols(bins)$bin_id <- seq_along(bins)


island_gr <-GRanges(seqnames = isl_annot$chrom,
                     ranges = IRanges(start=isl_annot$chromStart, end=isl_annot$chromEnd))
island_bins <- bins[countOverlaps(bins, island_gr) > 0]
pmd_ovcar8_bins <- bins[countOverlaps(bins, pmd_list[["OVCAR8"]]) > 0]

pmd_common_binds <- bins[countOverlaps(bins, pmd_common_gr) > 0]

sample_info <- tibble(
  Sample = c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53","UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1", "WEHI_CS62", "134011_1910_T4", "134062_9174_T4" ,"SFRC01428S1_22235_T2","134048_7794_T2", "SFRC01495S2_1537_T1", "SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2", "134169_6606_T2" , "SFRC01865S1_T1_2422", "SFRC01585S1_2163_T3", "SFRC01334S1_107_T5"),
  condition = c("HRP", "HRD", "HRD","HRD", "?","?", "HRD", "HRD", "HRP", "HRP", "HRP", "HRP","HRP", "HRP", "?", "?"),
 type = c("cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","cellline","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx","pdx"  ))

HRD_HRP_meth <- rbind(cell_line_5mc %>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov >= 5,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X"))) ,
  pdx_5mc%>%
  filter(Nvalid_cov >= 5,Nvalid_cov <= 100, chrom %in% paste0("chr", c(seq(1,22), "X"))))

cpg_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = HRD_HRP_meth$chrom,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = HRD_HRP_meth$start, end = HRD_HRP_meth$end),
  coverage = HRD_HRP_meth$Nvalid_cov,
  meth     = HRD_HRP_meth$fraction_mod,
  Sample   = HRD_HRP_meth$Sample
)

hits <- findOverlaps(bins, cpg_gr)

bin_meth <- tibble(
  bin_id = queryHits(hits),
  Sample = mcols(cpg_gr)$Sample[subjectHits(hits)],
  meth   = mcols(cpg_gr)$meth[subjectHits(hits)],
  coverage = mcols(cpg_gr)$coverage[subjectHits(hits)]
) %>%
  group_by(bin_id, Sample) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meth = sum(meth * coverage)/sum(coverage),
    n_cpg = n(),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_cpg >= 10) %>%
  left_join(sample_info, by="Sample")

bin_meth_cellline <- bin_meth %>%
  filter(type=="cellline") %>%
  mutate(feature = case_when(
    bin_id %in% island_bins$bin_id ~ "Island",
    bin_id %in% pmd_common_binds$bin_id ~ "PMD",
    
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

bin_meth_cellline%>%
  # filter(condition != "?") %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample= sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(feature= factor(feature, levels = c("Island", "PMD", "Other"))) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=alt_name, y=mean_meth, fill=condition)) +
  geom_violin(position=position_dodge(width=0.8))+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1,
               position=position_dodge(width=0.8))+
  facet_wrap(~feature) +  # PMD / Island / Other
  labs(y="5mC (%)", x="Sample") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=hrd_palette) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 A6-meth"),
                       c("OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 H4-KO")),
    method = "wilcox.test"
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("plots/globalmethylation_cell_line_5mc.pdf", height = 6, width = 16)

bin_meth_pdx <- bin_meth %>% filter(type=="pdx")

bin_meth_pdx$feature <- case_when(
  bin_meth_pdx$bin_id %in% mcols(island_bins)$bin_id ~ "Island",
  bin_meth_pdx$bin_id %in% mcols(pmd_common_binds)$bin_id ~ "PMD",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

library(ggridges)
bin_meth_pdx %>%
  filter(condition != "?") %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::select(Sample= sample, alt_name)) %>%
  mutate(feature= factor(feature, levels = c("Island", "PMD", "Other")),
         alt_name = factor(alt_name, levels =c("PDX #11", "PDX #62", "PDX #585","PDX #428","PDX #48", "PDX #495",  "PDX #951", "PDX #169", "PDX #865", "PDX #334"))) %>%
ggplot(aes(x=mean_meth, y=alt_name, fill=condition)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.6, scale=1) +
  facet_wrap(~feature, scales="free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=hrd_palette)+
  labs(y="5mC (%)", x="Sample") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=14)

ggsave("plots/globalmethylation_pdx_5mc.pdf", height = 15, width = 16)
```

## PMD tile

```{r}
library(GenomicRanges)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(fastcluster)
library(magick)
ht_opt$fast_hclust = TRUE
load("~/local/MMSeekR.data/data/hg38.blackList.rda")
genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38

# Define autosomal chromosomes
autosomes <- paste0("chr", 1:22)

# Get chromosome lengths
chr_lengths <- seqlengths(genome)[autosomes]

# Create 5kb windows
windows_list <- lapply(names(chr_lengths), function(chr) {
  chr_len <- chr_lengths[[chr]]
  tile_start <- seq(1, chr_len, by = 5000)
  tile_end <- pmin(tile_start + 4999, chr_len)
  GRanges(seqnames = chr,
          ranges = IRanges(start = tile_start, end = tile_end))
})

# Combine into one GRanges object
windows <- do.call(c, windows_list)
windows_df <- as.data.frame(windows)

windows_df <- windows_df %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom = seqnames, window_start = start, window_end = end) %>%
  left_join(hg38.blackList, by = join_by(chrom, window_start <=end , window_end >= start)) %>%
  filter(is.na(name)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(start, end,name))

lr_pmd <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/MMSeekR/*.bed") %>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x) %>%
            mutate(Sample = gsub(".multiModel.PMDs.bed", "", basename(.x))) %>%
            `colnames<-`(c("chrom", "PMD_start", "PMD_end", "Sample")))

windows_df <- windows_df %>%
  left_join(lr_pmd, by = join_by(chrom, window_start <= PMD_end, window_end >= PMD_start)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PMD_start, PMD_end)) %>%
  mutate(presence = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample,values_from = presence) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`NA`)


windows_df[is.na(windows_df)] <- 0

windows_df_sub <- windows_df %>%
  mutate(region = paste(chrom, window_start, window_end, sep = "_")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("region") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(chrom, window_start, window_end)) %>%
  filter(rowSums(.) != 0)


# Heatmap(windows_df_sub, cluster_columns = T, cluster_rows = F, use_raster = T, raster_by_magick = T, raster_quality = 1)

ovcar8_dmp <- windows_df_sub %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("OVCAR8")) 

ovcar8_dmp_common <- ovcar8_dmp %>%
  filter(rowSums(.) ==3 ) %>%
  rownames_to_column("region") %>%
  separate(region, into = c('chrom', "start", "end")) %>%
  mutate(start= as.numeric(start), 
         end = as.numeric(end)) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end)

OVCAR8_dmp_common_me <- ovcar8_dmp_common %>%
  inner_join(cell_line_5mc %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom, POS = start, fraction_mod, Sample),
            by = join_by(chrom, start <= POS, end >= POS))

OVCAR8_dmp_common_me %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = fraction_mod))+
  geom_violin()+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1)

ovcar8_dmp %>%
  mutate(presence = rowSums(.)) %>%
  group_by(presence) %>%
  summarise(N=n())



ovcar8_dmp_re_annot <- ovcar8_dmp %>%
  filter(rowSums(.) ==0 ) %>%
  rownames_to_column("region") %>%
  separate(region, into = c('chrom', "start", "end")) %>%
  mutate(start= as.numeric(start), 
         end = as.numeric(end)) %>%
  dplyr::select(chrom, start, end) %>%
  left_join(re_annotation %>%
              filter(!str_detect(rmsk_class, "\\?")), by = join_by(chrom, start <= rmsk_end, end >= rmsk_start)) %>%
  group_by(chrom, start,end) %>%
  summarise(rmsk_class = paste(unique(rmsk_class), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  inner_join(cell_line_5mc %>%
               filter(str_detect(Sample, "OVCAR8")) %>%
              dplyr::select(chrom, POS = start, fraction_mod, Sample),
            by = join_by(chrom, start <= POS, end >= POS))

ovcar8_dmp_re_annot%>%
  filter(str_detect(rmsk_class, "DNA")) %>%
  sample_n(2786032) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Sample, y = fraction_mod))+
  geom_violin()+
  stat_summary(fun = "median",
               geom = "crossbar", 
               color = "black",
               width = 0.1)
```

###SNV

```{r}
library(GenomicAlignments)
BRCA1_reads <- Sys.glob("Me_all/*extract_5mc_brca1.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x, col.names = ) %>%
            mutate(Sample = gsub("_extract_5mc_brca1.tsv", "", basename(.x))))%>%
  mutate(Meth = case_when(mod_qual >= 0.6 ~ "Me",
                         mod_qual <= 0.4 ~ "Un"),
         meBRCA1 = case_when(Sample %in% hom_me_list ~"Hom meBRCA1",
                         Sample %in% het_me_list ~"Het meBRCA1",
                         Sample %in% c("UWB1", "UWB1_BRCA1") ~"No meBRCA1"),
         meBRCA1 = factor(meBRCA1, levels = c("Hom meBRCA1",  "Het meBRCA1", "No meBRCA1"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter( base_qual >=20, !is.na(Meth)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(ref_position <=43125532+5000, ref_position >=43125192-5000, !inferred, mod_code == "m")  %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::rename(Sample = sample))


ovcar8 <- stackStringsFromBam("output/OVCAR8/OVCAR8_mapped_sc.bam", param = "chr17:43128267-43128267", use.names = T)
SFRC01428S1_22235_T2 <-stackStringsFromBam("output/SFRC01428S1_22235_T2/SFRC01428S1_22235_T2_mapped_sc.bam", param = "chr17:43128267-43128267", use.names = T)
SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2 <- stackStringsFromBam("output/SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2/SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2_mapped_sc.bam", param = "chr17:43128267-43128267", use.names = T)

het_SNV <- data.frame(read_id= c(names(ovcar8), names(SFRC01428S1_22235_T2), names(SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2 )), 
                      SNV =c(data.frame(ovcar8)[,1], data.frame(SFRC01428S1_22235_T2)[,1],  data.frame(SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2)[,1]),
                      SampleID = c(rep("OVCAR8", length(ovcar8)), rep("SFRC01428S1_22235_T2", length(SFRC01428S1_22235_T2)),rep("SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2", length(SOLACE2_0126S1_25285_T2))))
  


plot_list <- het_SNV %>%
  left_join(BRCA1_reads) %>%
  filter(! SNV %in% c("-" , "A"), !is.na(Meth)) %>%
  mutate(SNV = if_else(SNV == "C", "REF", "ALT"),
         SNV =factor(SNV, levels = c("REF", "ALT"))) %>%
  group_by(read_id) %>%
  mutate(med_meth = sum(Meth == "Me")/n()) %>%
  mutate(read_id = paste0(med_meth, "_", read_id)) %>%
  group_by(SampleID)%>%
  group_map(~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = ref_position, y = read_id, colour = Meth))+
               geom_rect(aes(xmin = 43125192 , xmax = 43125532, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = alpha("#d9d9d9", alpha = 0.6), color = "#d9d9d9", alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 43128267, linewidth = 1)+
    coord_cartesian(xlim =  c(43125192-3000, 43125532+3000) )+
    
  facet_wrap(~SNV, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2, nrow = 3)+
  scale_colour_manual(values = methylation_palette, "CpG Methylation (5mC)")+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle(unique(.$alt_name))+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()))


ggarrange(plotlist = plot_list, nrow =3, common.legend = T, legend = "bottom")

ggsave("plots/SNV_read_level.pdf", height = 5.5*1.5, width = 12)
```

```{r}
het_del <- data.frame(read_id= c(names(ovcar8_43124710), names(ovcar8_43126437)), 
                      SNV =c(data.frame(ovcar8_43124710)[,1], data.frame(ovcar8_43126437)[,1]),

         SNV = if_else(str_detect(SNV, "-"), "ALT", "REF"),
         SNV = factor(SNV, levels = c("REF", "ALT")),
         location = if_else(SampleID == "g.43124711_43124730del", (43124711+43124726)/2, (43126438+43126442)/2)) %>%
  group_by(SampleID)%>%
  group_map(~ ggplot(.x, aes(x = ref_position, y = read_id, colour = Meth))+

    coord_cartesian(xlim =  c(43125192-3000, 43125532+3000) )+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",

        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
```

```{r}
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, skip =  "Hugo_Symbol") %>%
            mutate(sample = gsub(".qanno.maf", "", basename(.x))))
tmb <- maf %>%
  filter(Hugo_Symbol != "unknown",Gene_Coding == "CODING", !Effect_Ontology %in% c("5_prime_UTR_variant", "3_prime_UTR_variant", "synonymous_variant", "intron_variant", "intergenic_region") & (! Variant_Classification %in% c("3'Flank", "5'Flank")), QFlag == "PASS") %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(n= n())%>%
  mutate(TMB = n/30)


write.csv(tmb, "output/tmb.csv",quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{r}
del_ovcar8s_seq <- isogenic_indel_ovcar8s %>%
  filter(type == "del") %>%
  mutate(start = POS, end = POS+ nchar(REF)) %>%
  group_by(`#CHROM`, start, end, SampleID) %>%
  group_map(~  detect_indels_in_region(readGAlignments(file = paste0("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/",unique(.y$SampleID), "/",unique(.y$SampleID),"_mapped_sc.bam"),use.names = T,

                                                  what = c("qname", "seq"))),

                      unique(.y$end),
```

###deletion

```{r}
del_ovcars_seq_df <- readRDS("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/del_ovcar8s_seq_df.RDS") %>%
  filter(read_type != "FAIL")
mod_ovcar8_p <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/clair3/OVCAR8_merged_SV_modkit_extract.tsv")%>%
              filter(mod_code == "m") %>%
            mutate(mod =case_when(mod_qual >= 0.6 ~ "Me",
                         mod_qual <= 0.4 ~ "Un"),
                   ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
              filter(!is.na(mod), base_qual > 20, ref_position != -1)

mod_ovcar8s <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/clair3/OVCAR8_LP*_merged_SV_modkit_extract.tsv") %>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x) %>%
            mutate(SampleID = gsub("_merged_SV_modkit_extract.tsv", "", basename(.x))))%>%
              filter(mod_code == "m") %>%
            mutate(mod =case_when(mod_qual >= 0.6 ~ "Me",
                         mod_qual <= 0.4 ~ "Un"),
                   ref_position = if_else(ref_strand == "-", ref_position -1, ref_position)) %>%
              filter(!is.na(mod), base_qual > 20, ref_position != -1, flag %in% c(0, 16)) 


del_ovcars_seq_df %>%
  dplyr::rename(read_id = ReadID) %>%
  left_join(mod_ovcar8s%>%
            dplyr::select(read_id,  forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod)) %>%
  filter(ref_position >= POS - 5000, ref_position <= POS + 5000)

common_del_reads <- del_ovcars_seq_df %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(SampleID)== 2) %>%
  ungroup()

common_del <- common_del_reads %>%
  dplyr::select(`#CHROM`, POS, type, indel_size, ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(start = POS - 5000, end = POS + indel_size + 5000) 

common_del_o_baseline <- common_del %>%
  left_join(mod_ovcar8_p  %>%
            dplyr::select(read_id,  forward_read_position, ref_position, chrom, mod_strand, ref_strand, read_length, mod_qual, base_qual, mod),
            by = join_by(`#CHROM` == chrom, start <= ref_position, end >= ref_position)) %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position, `#CHROM`, POS, indel_size, start, end) %>%
  filter(n()>=3) %>%
  summarise(meth_perc_p = sum(mod == "Me")/n()) %>%
  filter(meth_perc_p >= 0.8 | meth_perc_p <= 0.2)

common_del <- common_del_o_baseline %>%
  left_join(mod_ovcar8s, by = join_by(ref_position == ref_position, `#CHROM` == chrom)) %>%
  left_join(del_ovcars_seq_df %>%
              dplyr::select(read_id = ReadID, read_type, SampleID) %>%
              distinct()) %>%
  mutate(read_type = if_else(is.na(read_type),"REF", read_type)) %>%
  group_by(ID, SampleID, read_type, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_id) >2) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  group_by(ID, SampleID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type)==2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ID, ref_position) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(SampleID) ==2) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  dplyr::rename(chrom = `#CHROM`)

common_del_pileup <- common_del %>%
  group_by(ID, SampleID, chrom, ref_position, read_type, meth_perc_p, indel_size) %>%
  summarise(meth_perc= sum(mod == "Me")/n())

common_del_pileup_filt <-  common_del_pileup%>%
  dplyr::select(ID, SampleID, ref_position, meth_perc_p) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(common_del_pileup %>%
              filter(read_type == "REF") %>%
              dplyr::select(ID, SampleID, ref_position, meth_perc)) %>%
  filter(abs(meth_perc_p - meth_perc) <= 0.2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-meth_perc, -read_type) %>%
  distinct()%>%
  left_join(common_del_pileup ) %>%
  mutate( read_type = factor(read_type, levels = c("REF", "ALT")),
          SampleID = if_else(SampleID == "OVCAR8_LP_A6_30", "OVCAR8 LP A6-30", "OVCAR8 LP H4-53")) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = SampleID) %>%
  drop_na() 

common_del_pileup_filt %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`OVCAR8 LP A6-30`, `OVCAR8 LP H4-53`), names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "meth_perc") %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = meth_perc, names_from = read_type) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = indel_size, color = SampleID, y =abs(ALT - REF)))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap(~SampleID)+
  stat_cor(label.y = c(1.05))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))

common_del_pileup_filt %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `OVCAR8 LP A6-30`, y = `OVCAR8 LP H4-53`))+
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2)+
  stat_cor(label.y = c(1.05,1))+
  facet_wrap(~read_type)+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "OVCAR8 LP A6-30 (%5mC)")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, "OVCAR8 LP H4-53 (%5mC)")+
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA))
ggsave("plots/indel_del_overlap_ovcar8s_corr.pdf",height = 3, width = 5.5)



```

```{r}
motif_pos <-Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/output/landing_pad_mapping/meme_out/position_motif_*.txt") %>%
  map_dfr(~fread(.x, fill =T, skip = "severus") %>%
            mutate(motif = gsub("position_motif_|.txt$", "", basename(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(motif_width = nchar(V5)) %>%
  dplyr::select(ID = V1, motif_start = V2, motif_name = motif, motif_width) %>%
  mutate(motif_name_plot = case_when(motif_name == "1" ~"Motif 2",
                                     motif_name == "2" ~"Motif 4",
                                     motif_name == "3" ~"Motif 3",
                                     motif_name == "4" ~"Motif 6",
                                     motif_name == "5" ~"Motif 7",
                                     motif_name == "6" ~"Motif 1",
                                     motif_name == "7" ~"Motif 5",)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-motif_name) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`motif name` = motif_name_plot)

motif_dist <- DEL_seq %>%
  filter(changed) %>%
  inner_join(motif_pos) %>%
  mutate(SV_len = abs(SV_end - SV_start),
         motif_start_relat = (start + motif_start-SV_start)/SV_len, motif_end_relat = (start + motif_start-SV_start +motif_width)/SV_len)%>%
  filter(motif_start_relat>=0, motif_start_relat <= 1) %>%
  mutate(ID = gsub("_u|_d", "", ID))

motif_dist %>%
  group_by(changed) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(ID))

motif_dist%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = motif_start_relat,  y = ID,  color = `motif name`))+
  geom_point(shape =3)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  ylab("SV DEL Event") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("DEL start", "DEL end"), name = "Relative Position within SV DEL")+
  scale_color_manual(values= c("Motif 1"="#ff7480","Motif 2"="#fbb040", "Motif 3"="#fcec52", "Motif 4"="#99ca3c", "Motif 5"="#2bdae6",
                               "Motif 6"="#08b2f5","Motif 7"="#8178ff"))
ggsave("plots/del_changed_motif_distribution.pdf", width = 8, height = 3.5)

LT = list("Motif 1" = motif_dist%>% filter(`motif name` == "Motif 1") %>% pull(ID) %>%unique(),

          "Motif 6" = motif_dist%>% filter(`motif name` == "Motif 6") %>% pull(ID) %>%unique(),
          "Motif 7" = motif_dist%>% filter(`motif name` == "Motif 7") %>% pull(ID) %>%unique())


m <- make_comb_mat(LT)
pdf("plots/del_changed_motif_upset.pdf", width = 8, height =4)
UpSet(m)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
peaks_read <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/20241202_CUT_RUN/data/scaled_coverage/*rpcgscale.bedGraph")%>%

              mutate(SampleID = str_extract(.x, "(?<=scaled_coverage/).*?(?=_H3K[0-9]+me[0-9]+)"),
                     histone = str_extract(.x, "H3K[0-9]+me[0-9]+"),
                     rep = str_extract(.x, "rep[0-9]")) )


peaks <- Sys.glob("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/20241202_CUT_RUN/output/macs3/*Peak")%>%
  map_dfr(~ fread(.x) %>%
            filter(V1 == "chr17", V2 <= brca1_end, V3 >= brca1_start, V9 >= -log10(0.05))%>%
            dplyr::select(chrom = V1, peak_start = V2, peak_end = V3, peak_pval = V9) %>%
              mutate(SampleID =  str_extract(.x, "(?<=macs3/).*?(?=_H3K[0-9]+me[0-9]+)"),
```

```{r}
                  "Costimulatory Mol" = c("CD28", "CD40","CD40LG", "CD86", "ICOS", "ICOSLG", "IL6","IL6R", "STING1", "TNFRSF13B", "TNFRSF17", "TNFRSF18", "TNFRSF4", "TNFRSF9", "TNFSF13", "TNFSF13B","TNFSF18", "TNFSF4", "CCL2"),
                  "Chemokines"= c("CCL3", "CCL4", "CCL5", "CXCL9", "CXCL10", "CXCL11"),
                  "HLA" =  c("B2M", "HLA-A", "HLA-B", "HLA-C","HLA-DMA", "HLA-DMB", "HLA-DOA", "HLA-DOB", "HLA-DPA1", "HLA-DPB1", "HLA-DPB2", "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DQB1", "HLA-DQB2", "HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-DRB5", "HLA-DRB6", "TAP1", "TAP2"))


mat <- pdx_mrna %>%
  filter(`Associated Gene Name` %in% unlist(gene_list))  %>%
  mutate(alt_name = paste0("pdx ", alt_name)) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`, alt_name, log_tpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = alt_name, values_from = log_tpm) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Associated Gene Name")

gene_df <- stack(gene_list) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("gene", "group"))  %>%
  filter(gene %in% rownames(mat)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene")

Heatmap(mat,
        top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(`meBRCA1 Zygosity` =
                                            pdx_mrna %>%dplyr::select(alt_name, meBRCA1) %>%
                                             unique(.) %>% pull(meBRCA1),
        col = list(`meBRCA1 Zygosity`  = meth_zygosity)),
        left_annotation = rowAnnotation(gene = gene_df[rownames(mat), "group"]),
          row_split = 4)
```

```{r}
  filter(`Associated Gene Name` %in% unlist(gene_list),

  group_by(donorLabel) %>%

  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(`Associated Gene Name`, donorLabel, log_tpm) %>%
```

## plotting code

```{r}
DEL_reads_h453 %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  group_map(~
  ggplot(.x, aes(y = read_id, x= ref_position))+
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = max(SV_start, min(ref_position)), xmax =min(SV_end, max(ref_position)), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf ), fill = alpha("yellow", 0.01))  +
    geom_point(shape = 22, color = "black", aes(fill = mod))+
    facet_wrap(~read_type + ID, scales = "free_y", nrow =3)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = methylation_palette)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y =element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank()), .keep = T)
  


rbind(DEL_reads, DEL_P) %>%
  filter(ref_position < SV_start | ref_position >SV_end) %>%
  mutate(read_type = factor(read_type, levels = c("alt", "ref", "Parent")),
         relative_pos = if_else(ref_position < SV_start, ref_position - SV_start, ref_position - SV_end) ) %>%
  group_by(relative_pos, ID, read_type) %>%
  filter(n()>=3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(relative_pos, ID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(read_type) == 3 ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(relative_pos, ID, read_type) %>%
  summarise(meth_perc = sum(mod == "Me")/ n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = read_type, values_from = meth_perc) %>%
  mutate(baseline = ref - Parent, change = alt- ref) %>% 
  filter(Parent >0.8 | Parent <0.2) %>%
  group_by(relative_pos, ID) %>%
  filter(max(abs(change)) >0.8) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(alt, ref, Parent)) %>%
   filter(abs(baseline)<0.1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("baseline", "change"), values_to = "meth_perc", names_to = "read_type") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = relative_pos, y =meth_perc, group = read_type, color = read_type))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~ID, scales = "free_x")+
  theme_bw()
  

rbind(DEL_reads, DEL_P) %>%
  filter(ref_position < SV_start | ref_position >SV_end) %>%
  mutate(read_type = factor(read_type, levels = c("alt", "ref", "Parent")),
         relative_pos = if_else(ref_position < SV_start, ref_position - SV_start, ref_position - SV_end) ) %>%
```

```{r}
snv <- fread("intermediate/icgc_BRCA1_variants_hg38.tsv")%>%
  mutate(`Location` =paste0(gsub("chr", "", `#CHROM`), ":",POS ),
        AF = as.numeric(str_extract(INFO, "(?<=VAF=)[^;]+")))%>%

  filter(SampleType == "Primary tumour") %>%
  mutate(somatic = case_when(str_detect(TUMOUR,"Somatic") ~ "somatic",

                             TRUE ~"NA"))%>%
  mutate(Methylation = if_else(Donor %in% icgc_methylationlist$Sample.ID, "meBRCA1", "No meBRCA1"))

  mutate(zygosity = if_else(str_detect(TUMOUR, "0/1"), "heterozygous", "homozygous")) %>%
  mutate(zygosity = factor(zygosity, levels = c("homozygous", "heterozygous")))
```

```{r}
  mutate(total_cn = round(total_cn), B_cn = if_else(is.na(B_cn), 0, round(B_cn)),
    A_cn = total_cn - B_cn) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr =Chromosome, cn_start = Start_position , cn_end = End_position, cn =total_cn, SampleID) %>%
  filter(chr == "chr17", cn_start <= 43125532, cn_end >= 43125192) %>%
  mutate(cn = if_else(SampleID == "OVCAR8_LP_H4_53", 0, cn)) %>%
  inner_join(sample_name_mapping%>%
              dplyr::rename(SampleID = sample, Model = alt_name))

tmb <- fread("output/tmb.csv") %>%
  inner_join(sample_name_mapping%>%
              dplyr::rename(Model = alt_name))

HRD <- fread("output/hrdetect.tsv") %>%
  inner_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::rename(SampleID = sample, Model = alt_name))

mt <- promoter_region %>%
  left_join(sample_name_mapping %>%
              dplyr::rename(Sample = sample, Model = alt_name))  %>%
  filter(Gene == "BRCA1") %>%
  group_by(Gene, Model) %>%
  summarise(med_fraction_mod = median(fraction_mod))%>%
  mutate(med_fraction_mod = if_else(Model == "OVCAR8 H4-KO" &Gene == "BRCA1", NA,med_fraction_mod ),
         Model = factor(Model, levels =c("PDX #11",  "PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #62", "PDX #951", "PDX #169", "PDX #495", "PDX #428", "PDX #865","PDX #48", "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth" , "OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1")))%>%
  dt_pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = med_fraction_mod) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") 
rownames(mt) <- NULL


model_annotation = data.frame(Model = colnames(mt)) %>%
  mutate(model_type = if_else(str_detect(Model, "PDX #"), "PDX", "Cell line")) %>%
  left_join(CNV %>%
              dplyr::select(Model,cn)) %>%
  left_join(tmb %>%
              dplyr::select(Model,`TMB nonsilent` = TMB)) %>%
  left_join(HRD) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels =c("PDX #11",  "PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #62", "PDX #951", "PDX #169", "PDX #495", "PDX #428", "PDX #865","PDX #48", "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth" , "OVCAR8", "OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1")),
         `MeBRCA1 Zygosity` =case_when(Model %in% c("PDX #11",  "PDX #334", "PDX #585", "PDX #62", "WEHI CS62", "OVCAR8 A6-meth") ~ "Hom",
                                       Model %in% c("OVCAR8 H4-KO", "UWB1", "UWB1+BRCA1")~ "No Meth",
                                       TRUE ~ "Het")) %>%
  arrange(Model) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Model")



HRD_onco_plot <- Heatmap(mt, na_col = "grey", cluster_rows =F, cluster_columns = F,
         top_annotation =HeatmapAnnotation(
  Project = anno_block(
    labels = c("PDX", "Cell line"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  ),
  `TMB nonsilent` = anno_barplot(model_annotation$`TMB nonsilent`),
  `HRDetect score` =model_annotation$hrdetect_score,
  `BRCA1 CN` = model_annotation$cn,
  `meBRCA1 Zygosity` = factor(model_annotation$`MeBRCA1 Zygosity`, levels = c("Hom", "Het", "No Meth")),
  annotation_name_rot = 0,
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize= 10),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
   annotation_legend_param = list(`HRDetect score` = list(at = c(0, 0.7, 1), labels =c(0, 0.7, 1)),direction = "horizontal"),
  gp = gpar(col = "black"),
  annotation_height = unit(c(1, 4, 2, 2, 2), "lines"),
  col = list(`BRCA1 CN`  = `CN`, `HRDetect score` =HRD_color,
             `meBRCA1 Zygosity` = meth_zygosity)),rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.5),
  column_title = NULL, 
  heatmap_legend_param = list(direction = "horizontal",title = "Median Methylation %"),
    column_split = factor(model_annotation$model_type, levels = c("PDX", "Cell line")))

pdf("plots/model_description_Fig1.pdf", height = 5.7, width = 5)
draw(HRD_onco_plot, annotation_legend_side = "bottom", heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

```

##NBR2 expression in icgc

```{r}
library(ggbeeswarm)
icgc_methylationlist

df <- ICGC_tpm %>%
  filter(`Associated Gene Name` %in% c("BRCA1", "NBR2"), Sample_Group == "Primary tumour") %>%
  mutate(BRCA1_status = case_when(donorLabel %in% icgc_methylationlist$Sample.ID ~ "meBRCA1",
                                  donorLabel %in% c("AOCS-092","AOCS-130", "AOCS-086", "AOCS-079", "AOCS-171",
                                                    "AOCS-152", "AOCS-149", "AOCS-063", "AOCS-122",
                                                    "AOCS-147", "AOCS-148","AOCS-115") ~ "mutBRCA1",
                                  TRUE~ "wtBRCA1")) 
write.csv(x = df%>%
  group_by(donorLabel,  Sample_Group, BRCA1_status, `Associated Gene Name`) %>%
  filter(total_counts == max(total_counts)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(donorLabel, Sample_Group, BRCA1_status, `Associated Gene Name`, log_tpm) %>%
  distinct(), 
  file = "ICGC_BRCA1_NBR2_tpm.csv")

df%>%
  mutate(BRCA1_status = if_else(donorLabel %in%c("AOCS-158", "AOCS-057"), "low meBRCA1", BRCA1_status)) %>%
  group_by(donorLabel,  Sample_Group, BRCA1_status, `Associated Gene Name`) %>%
  filter(total_counts == max(total_counts)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BRCA1_status, y = log_tpm))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_beeswarm()+
  facet_wrap(~`Associated Gene Name`)+
  theme_bw()


ggsave("plots/NBR2_expr_brca1_status.pdf", height = 5, width = 7)
```
